quality.notes: rewrite_action_items applies one unchanged bound set to every item. ActionItem::Let rewrites only its initializer and never adds its name, so a later same-named variable is prefixed as component state or const, unlike binders handled by rewrite_statement and rewrite_expr.

The source confirms pattern is passed through, but provides no evidence that an Is pattern can contain a component-local type or state reference requiring qualification. Both component rewriting and compose alias resolution intentionally treat pattern as opaque, so the proposed mechanism is speculative and unsupported by this snapshot.

lower_compose collects Internal pairs without checking components or component action names, then uses them only to suppress exact matches. A misspelled alias or action therefore produces no error despite the function's documented unknown-alias/action error contract.
